name: com.daksh.sdk
description: Production Unity SDK for Daksh Game BaaS. Provides offline AES-256 caching, HTTP 304 ETag diffing, persistent offline action replay queue, PlayFab Economy V2 virtual currencies & catalogs, Leaderboards, Matchmaking, HTTP 206 resumable OTA AssetBundle downloaders, and Nakama-compatible real-time relay netcode.
